results.note: Part of Gerbert's letters translated by H. P. Lattin, The Letters of Gerbert with His Papal Privileges as Sylvester II, Columbia University Press 1961.
De causa diversitatis arearum in trigono aequilatero (mathematical treatise on triangle areas) — no English translation located. Latin scholarly editions by Olleris (1867) and Bubnov (1899) exist.
De corpore et sanguine Domini by Gerbert — no English translation found. (Note: authorship may be uncertain; this title more commonly attributed to Paschasius Radbertus.)
De geometria — major mathematical work; no English translation found despite scholarly interest. Latin editions by Olleris (1867) and Bubnov (1899).
De numerorum divisione (On Number Division) — no English translation found. Part of Gerbert's quadrivium works.
De rationali et ratione uti — no English translation found. Logical/philosophical treatise.
De sphaerae constructione (On the Construction of the Sphere) — no English translation found. Brief geometrical work.

Epistolae scriptae ante summum pontificatum (Letters written before his papacy) — translated by H. P. Lattin in The Letters of Gerbert with His Papal Privileges as Sylvester II, Columbia University Press 1961.
Excerpta e concilio Mosomensi (Excerpts from the Council of Mosomensis) — no English translation found.
Profession de foi (Profession of Faith) — very short work; may be included in Lattin's letters collection but no separate translation verification found.
Sermo de informatione episcoporum (Sermon on the Formation of Bishops) — no English translation found.
Supplementum ad epistolas (Supplement to the Letters) — included in H. P. Lattin's Columbia University Press 1961 edition of Gerbert's letters.
De fide spe et charitate (On Faith, Hope, and Charity) — no English translation found. Text available in Latin on Wikisource and medieval corpora.
De partu Virginis (On the Birth of the Virgin) — no English translation found. Dedicated to nuns of Soissons.
De passione SS. Rufini et Valerii (On the Passion of Saints Rufinus and Valerius) — no English translation found.
De vita S. Adalhardi (Life of Saint Adalhard) — no English translation found. Text available in Latin on Wikisource.

Epistola de corpore et sanguine Domini ad Frudegardum (Letter on the Body and Blood of the Lord to Fredugard) — English translation by Fr. Mark G. Vaillancourt in Corpus Christianorum in Translation series, vol. 34, Brepols.
Epitaphium Arsenii (Funeral Oration for Wala of Corbie) — English translation by Mayke de Jong and Justin Lake in Manchester Medieval Sources series.
Expositio in Matthaeum (Commentary on Matthew) — massive work (411K words); no English translation found. Critical Latin edition by Bedae Paulus in CCCM 56, 56A, 56B (1984).
Expositio in Psalmum XLIV (Commentary on Psalm 44) — no English translation found.
In Lamentationes Jeremiae (Commentary on the Lamentations of Jeremiah) — no English translation found. Text available in Latin on Wikisource.
Liber de corpore et sanguine Domini (Book on the Body and Blood of the Lord) — English translation by Fr. Mark G. Vaillancourt in Corpus Christianorum in Translation series, vol. 34, Brepols.
De casibus monasterii S. Galli (On the Affairs of the Monastery of Saint Gall) — no English translation found.
Poemata varia (Various Poems) — very brief work (120 words); no English translation found.

Scala paradisi (Ladder of Paradise) — attributed to Guigo II (Carthusian monk, d. 1188), not Bernard of Clairvaux. Free English translation available at ecatholic2000.com; also published in Cistercian Publications 1978 (Edmund Colledge & James Walsh, Cistercian Studies #48).
Appendix — attribution and content unclear; appears to be supplementary material in PL 182. Unable to determine what this appendix contains or if translation exists.

De interiori domo (On the Inner House/Interior House) — medieval English translation exists from 1499 by Wynkyn de Worde (Westminster), but availability and status as PD needs verification. Modern translations unclear.

Formula honestae vitae (Formula of an Honest Life) — authorship uncertain (possibly Martin of Braga originally, not Bernard); references to English translations in manuscript form exist but no clear modern published translation located.
In Canticum B. Virginis Mariae (On the Song of the Blessed Virgin Mary) — no English translation found.
In Dominica Palmarum (On Palm Sunday) — no English translation found.
In verba Matthaei cap. XIII v. 45 (On Matthew 13:45) — no English translation found. Biblical commentary fragment.
In verba Michaeae cap. VI v. 8 (On Micah 6:8) — no English translation found. Brief biblical commentary.
Lamentatio in passionem Christi (Lamentation on the Passion of Christ) — no English translation found.

Meditationes de humana conditione (Meditations on the Human Condition) — Pseudo-Bernard work; English translation by David N. Bell, The Very Devout Meditations attributed to Bernard of Clairvaux, Liturgical Press/Cistercian Studies (modern edition). Also 1701 English translation exists (PD).
Opusculum in verba: Ad quid venisti? (Small work on 'Why have you come?') — no English translation found.

De aris B. Mariae (On the Altars of the Blessed Mary) — part of Aldhelm's Carmina ecclesiastica (Church dedications); no standalone English translation found. May be included in Lapidge & Herren's prose works.
De basilica aedificata a Bugge (On the Basilica Built by Eadburh) — poem on church dedication; part of Aldhelm's Carmina ecclesiastica; no standalone English translation located.
De laudibus virginitatis (On the Praise of Virginity) — prose treatise; English translation by Michael Lapidge and Michael W. Herren, Aldhelm: The Prose Works, D. S. Brewer 1979.
De laudibus virginum (On the Praise of Virgins) — poetic version; English translation by Michael Lapidge and James L. Rosier, Aldhelm: The Poetic Works, D. S. Brewer 1985.
De octo principalibus vitiis (On the Eight Principal Vices) — part of Aldhelm's poetic works; English translation by Lapidge & Rosier in Aldhelm: The Poetic Works, D. S. Brewer 1985.
Diplomata (Charters/Diplomatic Documents) — included in Lapidge & Herren's Aldhelm: The Prose Works, D. S. Brewer 1979.
Epistolae (Letters) — English translation by Michael Lapidge and Michael W. Herren in Aldhelm: The Prose Works, D. S. Brewer 1979.
Fragmentum de die judicii (Fragment on the Day of Judgment) — no English translation found; very brief work (765 words).
In honorem apostolorum (In Honor of the Apostles) — very brief work (114 words); no English translation found. Likely a poem or titulus.

De septenario et de metris (On the Number Seven and on Meters) — large prose work on numbers and metrics; no English translation found. May be included in Lapidge & Herren prose works but not specifically confirmed.
